Absolute Power

by Mark Halpin

ANSWER: CEO

 
 

Answers to "Willow" clues can be paired with answers to "Dark Willow" clues. The latter is phonetically identical to the former except for one missing fragment. In each case, the fragment is the homophone of a letter. In "Dark Willow" clue order, the answers are:

AJAX / JACKSA
SEMITE / SIGHTM
ACCESS / AXES
ARMORY / MARIER
QUEUE LINE / KLINEU
WARRANTY / WARRENT
OAK LEAVES / CLEAVESO
PAYCHECK / PECKH
REVEILLE / REVELE
ELSEWHERE / SWEARL
GOATEED / GOADT
EAU-DE-VIE / ODAV
BEEFEATER / FETORB
BAHRAIN / BARNA
SHIVAREE / SHIVERE
ABE LINCOLN / BLYNKENA
GARLIC / GLICKR
CARAMEL / CAROML
ARCHIMEDEAN / COMEDIANR
CAVALCADE / CAVILEDK
CURFEW / KERFU
TEETOTUM / TOTEMT
CENTAUR / STOREN
PHARISEE / FARRAHC
ZEBRINE / BRINEZ
POTEEN / PUNT
BREEZY / BRIEZ

Missing letters are removed in a particular pattern in this list order: beginning of the word, interior of the word, end of the word, beginning of the word, etc. Dividing the letter string into first letters, interior letters, and last letters gives the sequences AROLBARTZ, MUHTARKNT, and STEVELUCZ. These are themselves missing a letter at the beginning, interior, and end of the sequence respectively. Restoring these letters gives three powerful people (Carol Bartz, Muhtar KEnt, and Steve LuczO) as well as their title, and the puzzle's answer, CEO.
